problem: A minimal-fix assessment found that exposing two already-existing fields (context.goal_id, decision.decision_summary) in the rearm guards' forced_reads output was sufficient to let a consumer distinguish exp_phase946_...(cap_dataset_management's own status) from exp_phase_e22_...(goal_semantic_quality's separate reclassification gate) as different real semantic targets, without any new ontology, schema, or ranking.

decision.decision_summary: Add goal_id and decision_summary (both already present on every Experience) to both rearm guards' forced_reads entries only. Keep the LPM overlay and pointerCurrencyGuard() as the sole authoritative current-status sources, unchanged. Never read Experience result.functional_status fields as a global capability-level fact independent of context.goal_id, and never rank/score/latest-wins between differently-goaled records.

action.action_summary: Edited genieGoalCapabilityCorrectionRearm.mjs and geniePointerCurrencyCorrectionRearm.mjs to expose goal_id + decision_summary in forced_reads. Extended both existing verifiers' fixtures with these fields and added a real, live positive control confirming exp_phase946_... and exp_phase_e22_... remain distinguishable via context.goal_id today. Ran both existing Self-Correction guards plus the full pre-existing GENIE regression suite.

evidence.evidence_detail: Live retrieveCanonicalLearning(capability_ref=cap_dataset_management) returns both 946 (goal_id=goal_repository_foundation) and E22 (goal_id=goal_semantic_quality) with contradictory-looking result.functional_status_after values but genuinely distinct goal_id, proving semantic-target distinguishability via an existing field alone. 11/11 pre-existing GENIE regressions plus 6+5 fixture checks (both rearm guards) passed. No retrieval API, historical Experience, or authoritative-status-source logic modified.

cause.root_cause_summary: The same field name (result.functional_status_after) is used across the corpus for both capability-level and goal-scoped-gate facts, but the discriminating field (context.goal_id) already exists on every record -- it was simply never surfaced by the two rearm guards' narrow forced_reads shape.

lesson: An apparent memory contradiction between two real, unrelated Experiences can sometimes be resolved by exposing a field the corpus already carries on every record (context.goal_id), rather than by inventing a new ontology, ranking scheme, or rewriting history -- the fix was surfacing existing structure, not creating new structure.
